title: A section satisfying the local derived-completeness criterion
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a small site with sheaf of commutative rings $\mathcal O$, with module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. For $K\in D(\mathcal O)$, $U\in\mathcal C$ and $f\in\mathcal O(U)$, define $\operatorname{IsCompleteElement}(K,U,f)$ to mean $R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_U}(\mathcal O_U[1/f][0],K|_U)=0$ [def-pur-derived-internal-hom], using the section-localization module [def-weil-pbc-ringed-site-section-localization] and restriction of the derived object [def-weil-pbc-ringed-site-derived-restriction].
